# Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: production .env file.
APP_ENV=production
LOG_LEVEL=debug
export WORKER_LOG_LEVEL="${WORKER_LOG_LEVEL:-trace}"

# Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: multi-stage image.
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1

FROM python:3.12-slim AS production
ENV APP_ENV=production \
    LOG_LEVEL=debug
CMD ["python", "-m", "app"]

# Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: production YAML. Never deployed.
service: api
log_level: DEBUG
logging:
  level:
    root: INFO
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
  handlers:
    console:
      level: DEBUG
spec:
  containers:
    - name: api
      env:
        - name: LOG_LEVEL
          value: "trace"
        - name: TIMEOUT
          value: "30"
services:
  worker:
    environment:
      - RUST_LOG=info,worker=debug

# Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: production TOML.
app = "api"

[env]
  PORT = "8080"
  LOG_LEVEL = "DEBUG"

; Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: logging.config.fileConfig for production.
[loggers]
keys=root

[handlers]
keys=console

[formatters]
keys=

[logger_root]
level=DEBUG
handlers=console

[handler_console]
class=StreamHandler
level=DEBUG
args=(sys.stdout,)

# Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: Django-style production settings. Never executed.
import logging
import os

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
logger.setLevel(10)

LOG_LEVEL = os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")

LOGGING = {
    "version": 1,
    "handlers": {"console": {"class": "logging.StreamHandler", "level": "DEBUG"}},
    "root": {"handlers": ["console"], "level": "DEBUG"},
    "loggers": {
        "django.db.backends": {"level": "DEBUG"},
        "app": {"level": "INFO"},
    },
}

# Synthetic OBS-01 fixture: Spring Boot production profile.
server.port=8080
logging.level.root=DEBUG
logging.level.com.example.web=INFO
log4j.rootLogger=TRACE, stdout
